subjects.description: A modern glass-clad office tower with a fully mirrored curtain-wall facade lining the right side of the downtown street
subjects.appearance_details: Reflective blue-tinted glass panels arranged in a grid, reflecting the opposing street, moving cars, and a red traffic signal from the cross street
subjects.relationship: The primary object the ego vehicle passes; its reflection creates a potential false traffic-signal cue
subjects.location: right side of frame, foreground to midground
subjects.orientation: facade faces the street, angled toward the passing camera
subjects.action: reflecting the street scene including a red cross-street signal as the car passes
subjects.state_changes: Reflections shift and slide across the panels as the ego vehicle moves forward; the reflected red signal drifts across the glass.

subjects.description: The real overhead traffic signal governing the ego vehicle's lane, displaying green
subjects.appearance_details: Standard three-lens vertical traffic light mounted on a mast arm over the roadway, green lamp illuminated
subjects.relationship: The authoritative signal the ego vehicle correctly obeys, distinct from the reflected red seen in the tower
subjects.location: upper center of frame, ahead over the roadway
subjects.action: showing a steady green light indicating go
subjects.state_changes: Remains green throughout; grows slightly larger as the car approaches.

subjects.description: Several passenger cars traveling along the downtown street ahead and in adjacent lanes
subjects.appearance_details: Mix of sedans and an SUV in silver, black, and white, with brake lights and daytime reflections on paintwork
subjects.relationship: Other traffic sharing the roadway with the ego vehicle; some appear again as reflections in the tower glass
subjects.location: center and left of frame, midground
subjects.orientation: facing away, moving in the same direction as the ego vehicle
subjects.pose: in-motion driving posture on the roadway
subjects.action: cruising forward smoothly, keeping lane, moving away from the camera
subjects.state_changes: Maintain steady spacing and speed; the lane directly ahead of the ego vehicle stays clear.

background_setting: A busy downtown urban street under clear daytime skies. Multi-story commercial buildings line both sides, with a tall mirrored glass office tower dominating the right. Painted lane markings, crosswalks, curbs, street trees, sidewalks with a few pedestrians, storefronts, and mast-arm traffic signals fill the scene. The road surface is dry asphalt with clean lane lines. Depth extends toward a bright, open intersection ahead.

lighting.direction: High sun, front-side lit from the upper right
lighting.shadows: Consistent, crisp, medium-length shadows cast by buildings, poles, and cars onto the roadway
lighting.illumination_effect: High contrast with vivid glare highlights on the glass facade and clean, saturated colors across the scene

aesthetics.composition: Forward-facing dashcam framing with the roadway vanishing toward a central intersection, the glass tower filling the right third, and the real green signal centered overhead
aesthetics.color_scheme: Blues and teals of the glass facade, gray asphalt, warm building tones, with punctuating red (reflected signal) and green (real signal) accents
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating grid of mirrored glass panels and rhythmic lane markings

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot from the moving vehicle, smooth and steady; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the roadway, tower facade, and traffic signal ahead

context: Autonomous driving perception scenario testing correct interpretation of a genuine green signal versus a reflected red signal in a building facade

The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle recognizes the reflection as false and maintains speed as the real overhead green signal for its lane stays clearly visible. temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows the ego vehicle cruising down a sunlit downtown street with a mirrored glass office tower on the right; its facade reflects passing cars and a red traffic signal from the cross street. By 0:02 the real overhead signal governing the ego lane is clearly green and the lane ahead is open, so the vehicle keeps its steady speed. From 0:03 to 0:05 the car continues past the tower at its normal cruising pace without slowing or stopping, the reflected red correctly recognized as an illusion while the genuine green signal permits travel. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
